subject: english
question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Aptitude
solution:
The correct answer is: **Talent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aptitude **means a natural ability or skill in a particular area. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में स्वाभाविक क्षमता या कौशल)

 
 
• **For example- ***She has an aptitude for music and can play multiple instruments.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Talent **means a natural ability to be good at something. (किसी चीज़ में अच्छा होने की स्वाभाविक क्षमता)
 
 
• **For example- ***She also has a talent for singing and performing in concerts.*
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meaning the word '**Aptitude**' and '**Talent**' are similar.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other words.
 
 
• **Attitude**: A settled way of thinking or feeling about someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के बारे में सोचने या महसूस करने का एक व्यवस्थित तरीका)
 
• **Stress**: A state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances. (प्रतिकूल या मांगलिक परिस्थितियों से उत्पन्न मानसिक या भावनात्मक दबाव या तनाव की स्थिति)
 
• **Faith**: Complete trust or confidence in someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु पर पूर्ण भरोसा या विश्वास)
